Strong red horizontal canopy-like strip, pale lower-storey wall, narrow vertical upper framing. Classification does not rely on chimney.

Repeated narrow vertical framing and stacked small dark window bays; dense facade reads later, but glazing and stone are unresolved.
Small plain house with restrained frame and isolated small window openings; no conspicuous jetty or continuous dark window band.
